Shared data: the plan and the activities it is built from, the questionnaire, the automated-processing rules, the organizations and the patients. The care team and practitioner are not shared, but are present here as placeholders referenced by the scenario resources (templates). The loader substitutes the placeholder care team and practitioner when it duplicates the scenario for each vendor.

Specialized.Definitional Artifacts

The plan, the activities it is built from, the questionnaire and the automated-processing rules.

PlanDefinitions

The monitoring plan: its branches, how each is scheduled, and the order its activities run in.

Name Description
COPD monitoring plan (oxygen saturation, pulse and questionnaire) COPD monitoring plan with a scheduled mon/wed/fri branch and an unscheduled extra branch, each carrying the saturation and pulse device group and the symptom questionnaire. One submission against the extra branch yields one questionnaire response and two observations.

ActivityDefinitions

One per step of the plan — the containers that group them, the guidance screens, the measurements and the questionnaire activity.

Name Description
Closing Closing guidance for a scheduled round.
Extra head activity Container for the unscheduled saturation, pulse and questionnaire.
Extra pulse Unscheduled heart rate, with the same absolute thresholds as the scheduled one.
Extra questionnaire Unscheduled Master Questionnaire activity, composed of the same questionnaire as the scheduled one.
Extra oxygen saturation and pulse (same device group) The unscheduled same-device group.
Extra oxygen saturation Unscheduled oxygen saturation, with the same absolute thresholds as the scheduled one.
Head activity Container for the scheduled saturation, pulse and questionnaire.
Introduction Opening guidance for a scheduled round.
Pulse Heart rate, triaged against absolute thresholds: red at or below 50 and at or above 130, yellow either side of the 60-110 green band.
Questionnaire Master Questionnaire activity presenting the symptom questionnaire, the single questionnaire of this plan.
Oxygen saturation and pulse (same device group) The same-device group: one pulse oximeter, one patient action, two values. Its children are the saturation and the pulse.
Oxygen saturation and pulse measurement Guidance shown before the saturation and pulse measurement: warm the hands, and what the reading involves.
Preparation Immediate preparation: sit still for five minutes beforehand and keep the hand steady during the reading.
Oxygen saturation Oxygen saturation, triaged against absolute thresholds: red at or below 85%, yellow up to 88%, green above.

Questionnaires

The questionnaire the plan collects, carrying the answer significance its triage rule reads.

Name Description
COPD questionnaire COPD symptom questionnaire: treatment status, three symptom scales, sputum colour and a conditional comment. Eighteen answer-significance mappings across green, yellow and red.

Libraries

The automated-processing rules the measurement and questionnaire activities point at.

Name Description
observation-absolute-range-triage Triages a submitted observation against absolute thresholds expressed in the observation's own unit. Reads the reference ranges from the observation it is given, so a measurement must carry them to be assessed; a GAL range yields a yellow assessment and a RAL range a red one.
questionnaire-response-triage-on-answersignificance Triages a submitted questionnaire response by matching each answer against the answer-significance mappings on the questionnaire, and recording one finding basis per answered question alongside the overall assessment.

Foundation.Other

Settings the loader reads before it loads anything. Not test data, and not created on the target.

Parameters

Loader settings, chiefly the anchor date every date in the data is relative to.

Name Description
Loader settings Read by the loader, never loaded. anchorDate is the day the scenario is written for: it maps to the load date, and every date in the data shifts by the same number of days. Table pairing the coexistence tag with the programme it runs: the loader substitutes ${COEXISTENCE_TAG} and ${EHEALTH_PROGRAM} together, making one copy of the vendor-scoped data per vendor listed here.

Bundles

Copies of the core IG code systems the loader checks the coexistence tags and programmes against.

Name Description
Loader code systems Read by the loader, never loaded. The ehealth-system and ehealth-program CodeSystems of dk.ehealth.sundhed.fhir.ig.core: the loader checks the coexistence tags against them, and adds any codes the terminology service lacks.
